preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
Size of permutation is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, len(a) == n
preconditions.description: Length of permutation array matches the specified size.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, all(0 <= a[i] < n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements in permutation are distinct integers from 0 to n-1.
Total sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, return_value == count_similar_permutations(a) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the number of permutations similar to the given permutation, modulo 10^9 + 7.
